en: Failed scores: the objects the game still counts as misses while the fail plays out are now included, so the miss count matches the game (scores are re-analysed once)

Home: big see-through osu!-style icons behind the three cards and scene changes – Live analysis: the hit circle bursts like a real hit with “300”; Studio: viewfinder with REC; Tablet: the pen drags an area across the screen like in OpenTabletDriver
Hidden scores: new “👁 Hidden” switch under the replay – turn Hidden off to see the circles and approach circles where you missed
No more console windows flashing up: the check for the system's Node.js (used by the lazer pp calculator) ran for every score without hiding its window – now it runs once and hidden
Relax scores: the miss analyzer no longer marks short sliders as slider breaks, and misses now match the game – relax clicks are worked out from where your cursor was (scores are re-analysed once)
Uninstall.bat: stops osu!review, removes shortcuts/autostart and the program - keeps your scores and settings (option 1, for updating) or deletes everything (option 2)

Tablet: playfield and aim view were drawn in the wrong place (even off the tablet) when another monitor sits left of or above the main screen – the screen osu! runs on is now located like OpenTabletDriver does it

Streams card per score: every stream on the timeline (click = watch it), stamina curve, timing drift, alternate/singletap with key balance, aim at corners vs. straight parts, your stream limit and the hardest streams

Jumps card per score: all jumps by distance and time with jump sections, clean % and over/undershoot by distance, direction rose, flow vs. angled vs. back-and-forth, corrections, path detour, peak speed and your jump limit (also in mm on your tablet)

Big/fullscreen replay: panels left and right of the playfield – what's happening now (stream/jumps/slider/break), live aim of your last jumps, cursor speed, live tablet with your pen, timing of the last 30 hits and a key overlay with tapping BPM
Timeline: stream and jump sections are marked at the bottom
Home: new “Your limits” card – best clean stream BPM, biggest clean jumps, wide-jump over/undershoot, trend and a tip
